requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: The CV states a B.A. in Visual Communication Design (Bukak National University), and the cover letter explicitly frames the candidate as "a frontend developer... not a signal processing engineer"; no demonstrated equivalent technical competence in electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics is described, so marked not_stated.

lines.quote: all client communication, code reviews, and documentation conducted in English

requirements.name: Onsite in Oulu / relocation
requirements.note: The cover letter expresses interest in Oulu's engineering community and asks whether a software-adjacent need might exist, but does not state a willingness to relocate to or work onsite in Oulu.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any hands-on experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ for real hardware, if any?
Can you describe your experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe your hands-on RF measurement experience, if any?
Can you describe any electrical engineering, physics, applied mathematics or closely adjacent qualifications or equivalent competence you have, if any?
